description.zh: QQ Bot 桥接增强包：整合原 qqbot_bundle 全部能力 + qqbot-pro 增强能力。收消息（增强 Gateway 事件全放开）、发消息（文本/Markdown/引用/输入态/图片）、自动回复桥（QQ→Operit 指定对话→AI 回复→QQ，waifu 三句号切分）、AI 主动发送（候选列表）；保留官方单聊 stream_messages 的架构位置，当前未实现。独立安装，可顶替原包。
description.en: QQ Bot Bridge Pro: merged capabilities of qqbot_bundle and qqbot-pro. Gateway receive, send (text/markdown/reference/input-notify/image), auto-reply bridge (QQ -> Operit chat -> AI reply -> QQ with waifu flush), AI proactive send (candidate list); reserves an architecture slot for C2C stream_messages (not implemented). Drop-in replacement for the original bundle.

description.zh: 撤回、文本/Markdown/引用/输入态发送、图片发送、群信息/群状态/机器人资料查询、AI 主动发送候选列表
description.en: Recall, send (text/markdown/reference/input-notify), image send, group info / bot state / profile queries, AI proactive target list

description.zh: 事件全放开 Gateway（含按钮回调 INTERACTION_CREATE、成员事件），独立端口 32146，队列读取/清空，互动回应
description.en: Enhanced Gateway with all events, port 32146, event queue, interaction respond

description.zh: QQ→Operit 对话→QQ 自动回复桥：轮询消息队列，桥接 Operit AI，waifu 三句号切分防消息限制，支持绑定指定对话/角色卡/环境变量
description.en: QQ -> Operit chat -> QQ auto-reply bridge with waifu sentence flush, pinned chat and character card support
